acceptance_met: Outcome branch (section 6): parent SHA measured first (seek cell 5 reps: 9.97 allocs/record, ~2000 CPU-ns/record); targeted cost sized at 0.125% of the named cell (<1% bar) via the KL04-09 decode microbench, so the remaining criteria do not apply and no src change was made.
commands: cargo bench --offline --locked --manifest-path benchmarks/codec/Cargo.toml --bench codec decode/f03 (500x100B batch: 24.94us median => ~50ns/record)
limits: Bound is generous: it prices skipped records at full decode cost, but any skip still parses offset varints and still pays CRC + batch overhead, so true savings are smaller.

Headerless synth decode allocates ~0 per record (zero-copy Bytes, no header Strings); the cell's 9.97 allocs/record live in consumer buffering/topic Strings (KL09-40 territory), untouched by this card.
Aborted-batch skipping (20% of the committed-aborts cell) bounds to ~0.2% by the same arithmetic; no cell carries control batches.
